response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than modern C++. C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month role in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, and there is no evidence of MQTT, message brokers in industrial contexts, IEC 62443/SDL practices, or industrial automation protocols. The core requirement of hands-on senior C++ development with industrial cybersecurity experience is not met.
strengths: Extensive senior-level experience (15+ years) with high-scale, low-latency systems (async I/O, fibers, microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, testable design, plus mentoring and workshop/teaching experience
Broad technology range including some systems programming (DLang, C/C++ at National Instruments) and event-driven architecture experience
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience; recent decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang
No industrial cybersecurity background — no IEC 62443, SDL, or secure-coding-for-OT evidence
No exposure to IoT/industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850) or automation machinery domain
